title: Pullback on the second cohomology with roots of unity is multiplication by the degree
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pullback map on the second etale cohomology with roots of unity for a nonconstant morphism of smooth projective curves over an algebraically closed field as multiplication by the degree (statement lines 11219-11228). The proof is a complete computation: the companion result identifies the two groups with Z/nZ, the generator is realized as the coboundary of the class of a degree one line bundle under the Kummer sequence (proof lines 11230-11236), and naturality of that coboundary together with multiplicativity of the degree under pullback gives the asserted multiplication (proof lines 11236-11242). The non-formal content is the choice of generators and the naturality argument. The claim is H2: a short but complete computation with each input named.
